messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty: HIGH - PD12345 triggered: kvcache eviction surge on gpu-pool-3 in us-west-2. 502 alloc failures, auto-pager fired.

pagerduty: Incident PD12345 created — dispatching page to oncall-jamie

oncall-jamie: Acked. Jumping in :hand:

oncall-jamie: Quick triage— is this across all models or one pool?

sre-amelia: metrics look bad for pool-3 specifically. kvcache insert rate spiked, eviction rate > 95% and we're seeing repeated cudaAlloc failures in runtime logs.

sre-amelia: Example error snippet:
```text
2024-06-22T14:05:01Z runtime ERROR cuda: out of memory while allocating 2147483648 bytes
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::bad_alloc'
```

infra-raj: Node-level view: gpu-node-12/13/14 exhibiting vmem pressure and slab alloc failures. K8s events:
```console
$ kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep gpu-pool-3
model-runner-aaa   2/2   Running   0   11m   gpu-node-12
model-runner-bbb   0/2   CrashLoop 5   4m   gpu-node-13
```

eng-runtime-lee: On it. Applying temporary kvcache limit increase and kicking rolling restart for pool-3. Command:
```bash
deployctl set config gpu-pool-3 kvcache.max_entries=600000000
kubectl rollout restart deployment/model-runner -n inference --selector=pool=gpu-pool-3
```

incident-bot: Auto-shedder triggered for gpu-pool-3 — new requests rerouted to gpu-pool-2. Latency SLOs protected.

oncall-jamie: Any confirmed customer impact? @support-maya

support-maya: Two customers opened incidents: acme-corp (500s -> 503) and beta-saas (timeouts). CS created INC-9823 and INC-9824. Both report partial degradation.

eng-runtime-lee: I'll try increasing per-pod reserved memory and restart; should reduce cudaAlloc failures. Starting now.

infra-raj: Also scaling pool-3 +2 nodes as emergency buffer: `kops resize group gpu-pool-3 --nodes +2`

pagerduty: PD12345 acknowledged by oncall-jamie. Escalation policy: escalate to SRE lead in 8m if unacked.

oncall-jamie: I'll own until stable. If not resolved in 20m, I'll escalate to @sre-lead.

eng-runtime-lee: kvcache config applied and rollout started. Monitoring logs: `tail -n 200 /var/log/inference/runtime.log | grep -i cuda`

sre-amelia: Seeing a drop in cuda_alloc errors ~7m post-restart. Eviction rate down ~70%. Auto-shedder still active but request success rate improving.

support-maya: Acme-corp confirms traffic restored. Beta-saas reports errors cleared.

oncall-jamie: Good. Keeping the thread open for 30m observation. Handoff scheduled at 1742506902 to @oncall-lee.

eng-runtime-lee: I'll open a follow-up ticket to root-causes: possible kvcache eviction regression after recent LRU tuning. Will attach logs and heap profiles.

pm-chris: Please capture customer impact timeline + affected model ids in the postmortem. Assign to ENG-456.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 auto-resolved (condition stable). Marking incident as mitigated — continue monitoring and follow-up postmortem.
